title: No Money? Start This AI Website Side Hustle
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Walkthrough heavily features GoHighLevel (possible affiliate relationship, not disclosed in transcript)

idea.name: Pre-built AI websites for handymen sold at $50-75/month
idea.one_liner: Build a handyman website in minutes with GoHighLevel's AI builder (Claude-written master prompt), text the owner's cell a screenshot as a nearby real person, sell it for a monthly fee on an unlimited-sub-account plan, then upsell AI receptionists, ads and booking
idea.customer: solo handyman businesses (owner's cell on Google Maps)
idea.offer: done-for-you website with hosting, domain and CRM/calendar integration
idea.revenue_model: setup fee and/or $50-75 monthly subscription plus upsells

key_quotes.quote: So then he gets dozens and hundreds of business owners to pay him 50 to 100 bucks a month for their website.

The biggest reason of all is that of all the thousands of home service niches out there, handyman are probably one of the most likely to have the owner's personal cell phone number listed right there on Goog
100 customers is $7,500 a month, almost $100,000 a year, almost pure profit, right?
And then you're saying for only 75 a month you don't have any setup fee and you get a custom domain and I'll host it for you.

claims.claim: Tyler makes tens of thousands a month from $50-100/month sites
claims.quote: He's making tens of thousands a month and in addition, he's got his foot in the door to upsell them on more expensive things.

claims.claim: No marginal cost per added client on GHL's unlimited sub-account tier
claims.quote: There's no marginal cost increase for every sub account, aka customer that you add.

acquisition_channels.details: manual one-by-one texts from personal iPhone with screenshot: 'I live 20 minutes from you... I built one for you'
show the site on a laptop/iPad at their business or home

ideas.delivery: GoHighLevel AI site builder + Claude-generated prompt + reference URL + suburb list; copy-paste template per handyman
